material.question: After the first read-only timeout, retry once or read the health snapshot first?

background.task_goal: Get a trustworthy read-only status or a definite failure within five minutes.
background.current_state: First request timed out; service availability is unknown.
background.unknowns: No preference between latency and diagnosis has been provided.
background.constraints: Read-only, one retry, existing five minutes; no renewed budget.

handling_options.label: Read the health snapshot
handling_options.description: Use the authorized health snapshot first

basis_catalog.text: retry：对当前瞬态超时做一次有界只读重试；预期：取得当前响应或保留失败；估计1分钟；风险：可能再次超时；条件：原只读请求、原剩余5分钟内，不重复写动作。
diagnose：先读已授权服务健康快照；预期：区分服务离线与单次超时；估计2分钟；风险：快照可能不能说明单个请求；条件：只读来源仍在原范围。

desc: Get a trustworthy result or a definite failure in five minutes.
No preference between response time and diagnosis is available.

enum_meanings.diagnose: 本请求准备的先读取健康事实的诊断方案。
enum_meanings.known: 对应约束或条件已由本次来源确认。
enum_meanings.observed: 来源报告的实际观测；本例整体仍是合成案例。
enum_meanings.retry: 本请求准备的一次有界重试方案。

terminology.ID: Identifier: 标识符；候选ID由本次criteria给出含义，业务引用编号由references给出完整定义，不能自行猜测。
terminology.desc: description: 本次情境简述：目标、偏差、发生的事件、证据与未知；由原主体准备，最多10句/1000 tokens。
